newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - AMR Corp price target raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - AMR Corp price target raised.

text.p: SCB Warburg Inc analyst Timothy Ross raised the firm's price target on AMR Corp to $115 from $108. The stock remains rated a buy.

-- In a research report, Ross said better-than-expected Q2 1997 earnings, a stock buyback program, the sale of a non-core data processing subsidiary and a winning bid to invest in Aerolineas Argentinas and Iberia should support the stock above its current levels.
-- Said the stock is trading at a deep discount to its peers despite a recent run-up.

-- "We believe that its run still has further to go as investors reassess their attitudes to the anomalously cheap airline sector and as AMR displays further examples of new-found investor-friendliness," he said in the report.

-- The stock was up 2-3/16 to 108 and touched a new year high of 108-1/4 amid broad buying in the transport sector. The Dow Jones Transport Index was up 21.50 to 2994.63 and hit a new year high of 2998.33.
-- Other airlines stock were also higher with Delta Air Lines Inc up 3/8 to 89 and UAL Corp up 2-5/16 to 82-1/2. UAL also reached a new year high of 82-7/8.
